replaces: j1-baseline-v1 (SHA-256 548466b4ed137e8cddd8c895a6cc8a818adcfccbdc4846ee3f09d8cfd10efe71) for the reference labels only; data, targets, conditions, runner, repeats, cost cap and metrics are unchanged
whyChanged: the blind human review of 81 cases was too heavy and was stopped before any final human label existed; the reference becomes an AI panel with a light human check of the disagreements
disclosure: this version was written after the gpt-6-luna T2 drafts existed and their decision counts per layer had been printed; no case content, rationale or human decision was used to write it
frozenBefore: the second panel labeller runs, the human check and the service judge runs

panel.memberA: existing gpt-6-luna drafts (labels-<ID>/t2-initial.json, tools/ai_labels.py, T1 v2, Topic, T2)
panel.memberB: a second OpenAI model, gpt-6 at reasoning_effort high, run by tools/ai_labels.py on the same blind handoffs into labels-gpt6-<ID>; the API model ID returned in run-record.json is reported
panel.independence: member B never sees member A's output; both see only the blind handoff

referenceLabels.agreement: per case, compare the two T2 decisions (PASS, REVIEW_REQUIRED, UNCERTAIN)
referenceLabels.silver: both members give the same decision: that decision is the silver label; an agreed UNCERTAIN stays UNCERTAIN and leaves the primary metrics, counted
referenceLabels.disagreement: the decisions differ, or either member's label is invalid: the case goes to the human check

humanCheck.what: not blind: the reviewer sees the target, a short transcript window and each member's decision with its rationale, and chooses which decision they agree with: A, B, or neither (UNCERTAIN)
humanCheck.result: the chosen decision is the final label; neither becomes UNCERTAIN and leaves the primary metrics; the reviewer may skip the whole check, and then disagreement cases leave the primary metrics and are counted as PANEL_DISAGREEMENT
humanCheck.context: for A4-T, the final label's context and evidence are those of the member whose decision was chosen; for silver cases, the union of both members' gold context and evidence

referenceLabels.freeze: final labels are frozen before the service judge runs and never changed after seeing its output

reporting.name: results are agreement with an AI-panel reference (silver labels), not accuracy against human ground truth
reporting.panelAgreement: member A versus member B agreement on all 107 cases with counts, per layer
reporting.humanCheck: number of disagreement cases, how many the reviewer sided with A, with B, or neither, or that the check was skipped
reporting.correlation: both members come from one vendor, so shared errors are possible and are not detected by this design
